name: City Depot Night Shift
description: A logistics depot inside a city block. Three drones share takeoff, patrol, inspection and recovery work while a no-entry warehouse blocks the middle of the map.
creator: Xie Qidong

targets.name: Charging Pad

tasks.name: Altitude Hold Checkpoint 1
tasks.content: Command Charlie to take off to 28.5 meters and hold that altitude, hovering in place while the sensor pod stabilises. The drone reaches its cruise height in the take-off itself; there is no second climb.

tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 2
tasks.content: Have Alpha take off to 26.4 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (259.2, 457.5), the south-east corner (642.2, 574.6), the north-east corner (768.9, 174.5) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 26.4 meters the whole time. Take a photo as it reaches every waypoint, including the return over the south-west corner, so four photographs in total, and finish hovering above that last waypoint. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
